Definition
[N-wave] 1. ch3:3.4.5-def-1\group Conservation Laws For $p,q\ge 0$, $d>0$, and velocity $\sigma $, define \[ N(x,t)=\begin{cases} \dfrac 1d\left(\dfrac {x}{t}-\sigma \right), & -(pdt)^{1/2}<x-\sigma t<(qdt)^{1/2},\\ 0,& \text{otherwise}. \end{cases} \]

Let $\sigma =F'(0)$, $d=F''(0)$, and \[ p=-2\min _y\int _{-\infty }^y g(x)\, dx,\qquad q=2\max _y\int _y^\infty g(x)\, dx. \] Then $p,q\ge 0$ and $G'(\sigma )=1/d$.
